adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, `calendarReference` was changed from `find` to `filter` so `updateAllCalendarEvents` now processes *all* `_calendar` references (multi-host/multi-destination). However, in the merge-cleanup block immediately after (`if (newBookingId) { ... }`), it still uses `booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"))` to locate the old calendar event to delete. With the diff also introducing multi-destination event creation (`createAllCalendarEvents` now iterates `event.destinationCalendar` and can create multiple events/references), the merge-cleanup path will only delete the first old calendar reference, leaving remaining old host events undeleted (orphaned) for bookings that had multiple `_calendar` references.
